zh: 删除一个AWS后左右两部分会拼接起来，可能形成新的AWS，所以需要一种能自然处理“删完再接上”的结构。
用栈来模拟，逐个字符入栈；已在栈中的前缀不可能再被删除，新的AWS只可能以刚入栈的字符结尾。AWS的前缀和后缀没有重叠，删除顺序不影响最终结果。
每压入一个字符，就检查栈顶三个字符是否依次为A、W、S，是则把这三个弹出；扫描结束后栈中内容即为结果，栈为空时输出-1。
en: After an AWS is deleted, the left and right parts join and may form a new AWS, so you need a structure that naturally handles joining after deletion.

Simulate with a stack, pushing characters one by one; the prefix already on the stack can never be deleted again, so a new AWS can only end with the character just pushed. AWS has no overlap between its prefixes and suffixes, so the deletion order does not change the final result.
After each push, check whether the top three characters are A, W, S in order and pop them if so; when the scan ends, the stack content is the result, and print -1 if it is empty.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Push characters onto a stack one by one, and whenever the top of the stack is exactly AWS, delete those three characters.

## Proof of correctness

Before a character is pushed, the prefix on the stack is already undeletable, so a newly formed AWS can only end with the new character, and the prefix exposed after a deletion is still a previously undeletable stack prefix. AWS has no non-empty proper prefix equal to a suffix, so two occurrences that are deletable at the same time do not overlap and their deletions commute; any deletion order gives the same result.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
